about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am an International Economics graduate (GPA 3.89/4.0) with hands-on research experience in behavioral finance and econometric analysis, combined with practical exposure to international trade operations.
about.paragraph2: Proven ability to lead research teams, interpret quantitative model outputs, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights that bridge analytical rigor with real-world business context.
about.paragraph3: I am seeking a Strategy/Research Analyst or Consulting role where cross-functional thinking and data-driven analysis drive meaningful business impact.
